rich_city.trigger_note: In theory, this would all be equivalent to a wealthy city ingame, but a rich city is not really a triggered state, rather a plain description for an ingame city used for targeted simulations, which imagines a large well supplied city with access to trade routes and various resources

harms to health.text: Toxicity thresholds, alcohol consumptions, tobacco consumption, contaminants, poisoning, pesticides, environmental pollutants

nutrition (MAR) to growth or fertility.text:
Strength: Logarithmic relationship to protein consumption and health

Fertility: Function where excess energy and nutrients boost fertility under the condition that toxicity thresholds aren’t reached, harmful substances harm fertility, animal foods and desserts disproportionately boost fertility, clams disproportionately boost fertility

nutrition to commerce, science, culture.text: Excess energy and nutrition boost commerce (commerce is the yield, gold science culture espionage are the outputs), under the condition that toxicity thresholds aren’t reached

high-protein foods to unit strength.text: Logarithmic relationship of unit strength to protein consumption, minimal protein consumption (50g of protein a day) provide a unit at 30% of the regular strength, adequate protein consumption (1.6g per kg of bodyweight) provides a unit at 80% of the unit strength, high protein consumption (above adequacy capped at the liver limit (roughly 288g per day)) raises the strength of the unit, capped at 200%

starving to population.text: Decline per turn or a negative growth rate
starving to population.note: Population doesn’t breed, possible mass die-off

iodine to research or culture.text:
Iodine below 150 µg: Decline from 100 IQ down to possibly two standard deviations less (limit: 70 IQ)

Iodine at 150 µg: 100 IQ

Iodine above 150 µg: Rise from 100IQ up to possibly one standard deviations (limit: 115 IQ)

Iodine above 1mg: IQ remains stable until 5mg

Iodine above 5mg: Toxicity, IQ declines from 115 until complete annihilation at 5g
iodine to research or culture.note:
Independent IQ variable, every point above and below 100 has an exponentially larger effect on output (positive and negative)

IQ is a complex variable that has its own function, and relates to the output in all yields (food, production, commerce (gold, research, culture, espionage outputs of commerce))

Proper yields impossible below 70IQ, only subsistence can be achieved there on a very small scale (1000-2000 pop), barely any commerce, low IQ a is genuine civilizational extinction level threat

meat_total.note:
Actual population consumption of the meat in total

Each livestock (cattle, pig, sheep, horse) and deer count towards “meat”, even though the game might distinguish between beef and mutton and pork etc

ceilings_g.salt_note: could physically take above that threshold, but toxicity is documented for acute one-time doses, 20g across the day however is physiologically manageable, although potentially harmful like alcohol

BONUS_WHEAT.note: People usually make bread, plain grain is not nutritious and has to be cooked to porridge or made to flour and bread, ideally fermented

BONUS_RICE.note: Brown rice carries too many contaminants and heavy metals

BONUS_CORN.note: It’s possible to eat cooked grain, however corn is also made to flour and into bread

BONUS_DAIRY.note: everything was eaten, but fresh milk was preferred to cheese, which was a way to preserve the nutrients in milk, and butter, which is more of a baking ingredient or cooking fat

BONUS_SUGAR.note: molasses are a lot more nutritious but are consumed with bread, brown sugar is more nutritious but not consumed as much recently

BONUS_TEA.note: Greeks had Mountain tea, thyme tea, various cultures made tea from sage and other herbs, better to group them together
